notes: The list, together with the IMSLP queue, already covers almost all of Elgar's original violin output. The only clear gap is the composer's own violin-and-piano version of Canto popolare. I left out other possible Elgar arrangements, such as Carissima and May Song, because I could not confirm a published violin-and-piano edition.
